notes.title: Gods of Fire – Major Update is LIVE!
notes.notes:
[p][i]Gods of Fire[/i] is a [b]free-to-play, team-based dragon shooter[/b] featuring [b]fast-paced aerial battles[/b] and [b]heated ticket-based warfare[/b].[/p][p]Take flight in [b]5v5 dragon battles[/b], where every kill and every captured base brings your team closer to victory.[/p][p][/p][p]This update introduces a [b]completely rebuilt version of the game[/b], packed with huge upgrades and fresh content.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s New[/b] 

🌍 [b]New Map[/b][/h3][p]Battle across vast zones, hidden relics, and tactical objectives. Use the environment to your advantage — from wide open skies to narrow passages perfect for ambushes.

⚔️ [b]Team-Based Mode[/b][/p][p]Coordinate with your squad to capture objectives, defend key landmarks, and disrupt enemy control. Teamwork and firepower will lead you to victory.[b]

🎟️ Ticket System[/b][/p][p]Each team starts with a fixed number of tickets — the team’s global lives.
Tickets are reduced when players are eliminated or when bases are captured.
Once a team runs out of tickets, the match is lost.
If time runs out, the team with the most tickets wins.
👉 Tickets cannot be recovered — once lost, they’re gone for good.[/p][p]
🎨 [b]New Skins[/b][/p][p]Express your style with [b]cosmetic-only dragon skins[/b]. Stand out on the battlefield with unique looks that match your playstyle.[/p][p][/p][p]🃏 [b]Consumable Battle Cards[/b][/p][p]Equip up to two cards per match for tactical boosts — from[b] extra XP and GPoints[/b]. 
[b]Amplifiers - [/b]Use them to [b]double your level-up rewards[/b] and maximize progression.[/p][p][/p][p]💎 [b]Loot Chests & Rewards
[/b] Unlock chests with keys to discover:[/p][p][b]Dragon Skins[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rare skins that can only be unlocked from chests[/p][/*][*][p]Skins also available in the shop[/p][/*][*][p]Even duplicates of skins you already own [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Consumables & Amplifiers[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Boost your matches or double your level-up rewards
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gold & GPoints[/b] – currency to fuel your progression[/p][p][/p][p]👉 Early players receive [b]5 free keys[/b] to get started!

🔥 The skies await — Download [b][i]Gods of Fire[/i][/b] now and [b]CONQUER THE ENEMY BASE![/b][/p][previewyoutube="ogHbJlW0bNM;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Servers Temporarily Offline – Preparing for a New Update
notes.notes:
Thank you for testing the game during this stage of the Early Access phase of Gods of Fire and for sharing your feedback, which has helped us shape and improve the experience.

We have temporarily shut down the servers as we prepare for the next major update.
This update will bring significant changes and redefine the game as we advance in development.

[i]What’s Coming in the New Version?[/i]

[b][i]A brand[/i][/b] - new map with a completely different story – A new world, ready to explore.
[b][i]A new game mode[/i][/b] - More strategy, more action!
[b][i]New dragon skins[/i][/b] - Fresh customization for your warriors.
[b][i]A complete monetization overhaul[/i][/b] - A refined and more rewarding experience.
[b][i]A fully redesigned menu[/i][/b] - A new UI to match the game’s evolving vision and ensure smoother navigation.

Check out some work-in-progress screenshots from the new map, taking shape!

notes.title: Update Release - Enhanced Gameplay and New Features!
notes.notes:
Dragon Players,

We’re excited to announce a [b]new update[/b] for Gods of Fire! We’re continually working to enhance the game and provide you with a better gameplay experience, featuring several improvements based on your valuable feedback.

Here’s what you can expect in this update:

[b]Improved Aim Assist[/b]
We've fine-tuned the aim assist to provide smoother and more accurate targeting.

[b]Kill Notification Spot[/b]
Added visual indicators for kills:
• Yellow for kills made by other players.
• Red for kills made by you.

[b]Kill Notification Sound[/b]
Added a distinct notification sound when a kill is made to enhance the gaming experience.

[b]NPC (Non-Player Character)[/b]
Introduced NPC bots to ensure all matches are filled and provide a complete gaming experience.

[b]Reduced Session Creation Time[/b]
Decreased the time required to create a new game session, allowing you to get into the action faster.
Other Small Bug Fixes

Various [b]minor bug fixes[/b] to improve overall game stability and performance.

We appreciate your support and feedback. Dive into the game and experience these new features!

If you’re a fan of dragon games, action games, or simply looking to discover the Dragon's Valley, we invite you to join our growing community. 
Follow us on our social media channels to connect with fellow players and stay informed about all the exciting developments.

Learn More About Gods of Fire:
[url=https://godsoffire.io/]Official Website[/url]
[url=https://x.com/godsoffire_io]Twitter[/url]

Best regards,
The Gods of Fire Development Team

notes.title: New Update: Enhancements and Fixes
notes.notes:
We've made a small update for Gods of Fire! Here are the details of the enhancements and fixes we've made:

[list]
[*] Highlight level-up rewards inside the main menu.
[*] Highlight/show scroll rewards inside the level-up menu.
[*] Highlight client name in the player's tab (Highlight your name in gameplay while pressing TAB).
[*] Healing zone will continue to update your health if you enter the healing zone with the regeneration perk activated (after the regeneration perk has finished increasing your health).
[*] Healing zone sound will end if your health is full.
[*] Solved Steam Store bug that occurred while buying an item.
[*] Added a preloader to the Steam Store while waiting for an item to be purchased.
[*] If a new update occurs, a popup message will appear while you're inside the game, prompting you to upgrade to the new version (Update is mandatory; otherwise, it will kick you from the server).
[*] Minor UI changes
[*] Minor bugs fixed
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and continued support!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089418/416429ea7abd6bd479366f00bfe802fd38d8da61.png[/img]

notes.title: Gods of Fire Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Hello, Adventurers!
We’re just a few days away from the [b]Early Access[/b] launch of [b]Gods of Fire[/b], set for [b]July 19th[/b]! 
Let’s dive into some of the game’s key features that will help you prepare for your epic battles ahead. 
Be sure to add Gods of Fire to your wishlist on Steam so you can be among the first to join the adventure!

[h2][b]Intense PvP Action[/b][/h2]

[b]Gods of Fire[/b] is a PvP multiplayer action game where players command powerful dragons in fierce battles.
Compete with up to 5 players for [b]control of the Dragons Valley[/b]. Take control of your dragon, unleash fiery breath, launch fireballs, and use special perks to dominate the battlefield.
Explore the fantasy world of the Dragons Valley, where chaos reigns, and strive for supremacy. Utilize strategic skills and map knowledge to outmaneuver and defeat your opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089418/9ced1ecb9fbf4aa5d41747d41830b2dcaff806b7.png[/img]

[b][h2]Healing Zones[/h2][/b]

In the Dragons Valley, you'll discover special [b]healing zones[/b] distinguished by their green glow. 
These spots provide essential health regeneration during battles,  allowing your dragon to recover while staying inside. Mastering these healing zones can change the course of battle and provide a strategic advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089418/472bd4e5606bb036d12276c3e022b1e56d5d5303.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dragon Diamonds[/b][/h2]

[b]Dragon Diamonds[/b] are a special resource that offers significant XP boosts for players and enhances the competitive and strategic aspects of the game, making every match more dynamic and engaging.

[i][b]Spawn Locations[/b][/i]: Dragon Diamonds spawn randomly in three spots on the map at the start of each match.
[i][b]Capture for XP Boost[/b][/i]: When a player captures the diamonds, their XP increases significantly for as long as they hold them.
[i][b]Strategic Gameplay[/b][/i]: Other players can hunt down the dragon carrying the diamonds to steal them and gain the XP boost for themselves.
[i][b]This feature adds a layer of strategy[/b][/i]: will you capture the diamonds and risk becoming a target, or avoid them to focus on other objectives?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089418/a124a355b24e5d6274e73b9c2e4c44e101719175.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dragon Classes | Upgrades | Perks[/b][/h2]

In Gods of Fire, players can choose from three distinct dragon classes: [i][b]Common[/b][/i], [i][b]Epic[/b][/i] and [i][b]Legendary[/b][/i]. Each class features [b]10 unique dragon skins[/b], giving you a total of 30 options to select from, each with its own special abilities. 
Choose the dragon that best aligns with your combat style!

As you progress through the game, you can [b]upgrade your dragon[/b] skins up to 10 levels, increasing their power and enhancing their combat capabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45089418/ee5382d3c1fa061ceb30625c7288ebadd59b7103.png[/img]

There are five distinct dragon perks, each providing unique abilities for the dragons. Each dragon skin is assigned one of these special perks. 
Use the perk in the right situation to gain an advantage in battle.
[i][b]Nebula[/b][/i]: Strategically place plasma orbs across the map that explode after a few seconds, inflicting damage on enemies who enter the area.
[i][b]Regeneration[/b][/i]: Restores health, boosts resilience in battles and facilitates recovery from injuries sustained during fights.
[i][b]Arcane[/b][/i]: Activate a shield for a few seconds, making you immune to damage from enemy attacks, as well as other environmental impacts.
[i][b]Phantom[/b][/i]: Disables aim assistance for enemies, making you harder to target for a few seconds. You won't be an easy target!
[i][b]Noxious[/b][/i]: Unleash toxic gas to harm enemies, draining their health and granting strategic advantage in battle.

Don't miss out on the action! Add Gods of Fire to your Steam wishlist to be among the first to join the battle on July 19th. Get ready to unleash your dragons and dominate the skies!

Join our community and stay updated for the latest news!
